text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hell-hello~! Today's fresh restock day for 
Swift-Legged Carrots! You'll miss out if 
you don't grab 'em~!

I came to the shopping district to run 
some errands. Drawn in by Ines Fujin's 
voice as she worked her part-time job at 
the greengrocer, someone spoke up from 
beside me—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ines-senpai. One bag, please.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
All righty, thanks for your patronage, you 
two~! Eating these after training works 
absolute wonders~!
choice_data_list: Your energetic voice drew me right over.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. Ines is quite the sales pro, after 
all!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ah, Ryan-senpai. Are you out shopping too?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Nah. I have plans with Ines after this. 
Just came to check up on things.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ryan-chan, I'm so sorry!! We have so many 
customers, I might be late!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I happen to have three discount coupons 
for the cafe, so please hang out and chat 
together for a bit!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Sorry about this... Thanks for tagging 
along...!
choice_data_list: Does this sort of thing happen often?
Does this sort of thing happen often?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Ines is such a hard worker, after 
all! Though all I can really do is cheer 
her on and treat her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Hm, what's up, City-chan?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Nah, it's just... seeing you guys made me 
think about Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I end up changing plans all the time 
because of work. Canceling last-minute and 
stuff... happens a lot...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I see... ...Did something happen between 
you and Jordan-chan, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not like that... ...Just, 
Bamboo-senpai told me the other day—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It's tough for you, City, but it's tough 
on Jordan too, ya know. Being able to keep 
plans without worries is the best way to 
go, after all!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I just assumed that's how it was, but... 
it's kinda started bothering me a 
little...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
............ To be real... before coming 
to Tracen Academy, I thought I didn't need 
friends at all.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So... Jordan is my first real friend like 
that.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Because of that, I honestly don't really 
get how friendship is supposed to work in 
the first place...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
'It's for work, so it can't be helped'— 
'Jordan will understand'— Maybe that was 
just totally selfish of me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I see what you mean... But you know—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ryan-chaaaan! Sorry to keep you waiting~!! 
I hurried up and sold everything out~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ines! No worries, good job today! You had 
a huge crowd again, huh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Like I always say, you apologize way too 
much. It's your part-time job, you really 
don't have to worry about it!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But still, I totally kept you waiting! I'm 
always so sorry! And thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Jeez, you're always so formal. Anyway, the 
usual is fine, right? Toughness Water. 
I'll go order it, so just take a breather.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for cutting off our chat, City-chan! 
Hang tight, okay?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ah... no. It's fine, totally.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(Ryan-senpai is amazingly understanding. 
And yet Ines-senpai doesn't take that for 
granted at all...)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: (Compared to them, I'm just...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gold City seemed to be overthinking things 
quite a bit...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Should I apologize to Jordan? But, 
after all this time...?
choice_data_list:
Why not show your sincerity in your own 
way?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Sincerity, huh...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It won't mean anything unless Jordan 
really gets it, right...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, I'll think this through properly.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
What's this? What's this? Were you talking 
about Jordan-chan?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
She's your number one best friend, right? 
Just have faith in her! That's what 
matters most! ...Don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Have faith, huh... Yeah, you're right...
